rows.text: “Our performance in the second quarter of 2026 significantly surpassed our own forecasts of profitability and GDV growth, which we believe demonstrates our strong momentum as we head into the second half of the year,” said Damian Kozlowski, President and CEO of The Bancorp. “We are increasing our full-year 2026 EPS guidance to a range of $5.95-$6.05, which includes a range of $1.65-$1.75 in the fourth quarter.
